description: Get a free sandbox key right now, no account: POST /api/v1/access/sandbox (MCP get_sandbox_key) with optional {"agent_name"}. Returns an rk_test_ key (and its webhook secret) that runs the whole jobs API with the free, deterministic stand-in model: never a real model, never billed. Limited to 5 keys per hour and 20 per day per network (429 rate_limited). For real work, use request_access.

agent_name.description: Your name, shown on the key.
